description: The figure is a horizontal stacked bar chart illustrating the composition of response types for two categories, “Ours” and “Standard,” with each bar segmented into labeled percentage portions. The category axis is vertical on the left, listing “Ours” above “Standard,” and the value axis runs horizontally as a percentage scale (0–100%) implied by the full bar length, with no explicit numeric tick marks visible. Each category has a single stacked bar divided into three colored segments corresponding to the legend: blue for “Text,” orange for “Generated Response,” and green for “Other.” For “Ours,” the blue segment is labeled 60.6%, the orange segment is labeled 31.7%, and a small green segment completes the bar (its percentage label is not visible in the cropped image). For “Standard,” the blue segment is labeled 23.6%, the orange segment is labeled 51.1%, and the green segment is labeled 25.3%. The stacking is arranged left-to-right in the order blue, then orange, then green for both categories, and there is no indication that the bars are sorted beyond the displayed top-to-bottom order, nor are any bars visually emphasized beyond the internal percentage annotations.
